text: A股三大指数午后均涨超1%，算力硬件、半导体芯片、农业、消费电子等方向领涨，沪深京三市上涨个股超3200只。
text_en: All three major A-share indices rose over 1% in the afternoon, led by computing hardware, semiconductor chips, agriculture, and consumer electronics, with more than 3,200 stocks rising across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets.
